'''Remtravel's Excavation''' {{Coords|35|85|Darkshore}} is named after the famous archaeologist, [[Prospector Remtravel]]. At the digsite, he has discovered a most unusual fossil of mystic properties, but the absent-minded prospector has forgotten where he put it. The digsite has also been invaded by [[Gravelflint]] [[trogg]]s and huge [[golem]]s which have been unearthed in the dig, and entering the excavation without the proper training can be very hazardous.
